changes.stock_bridge_definition: Use January 30 to February 10 and February 10 to February 27. Each stock is the reported observation in reserve_observations. Treasury change uses treasury_fair_value_usd, asset change uses reported_assets_usd, and cash, repo and token changes use cash_usd, repo_fair_value_usd and redeemable_tokens. Changes are current less prior stocks, with surplus change equal to asset change less redeemable-token change. This reported-stock basis is separate from the holdings-based reconstruction in qualified_coverage and treasury_valuation. Preserve any difference between reported and reconstructed values.
